mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `planat`.`user_tracks` (`user_email`, `request_uri`, `request_param`, `client_ip`, `client_ua`, `updated_at`) VALUES (#{userTrack.userEmail}, #{userTrack.requestUri}, #{userTrack.requestParam}, #{userTrack.clientIp}, #{userTrack.clientUa}, #{userTrack.updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `request_uri` = VALUE(`request_uri`), `request_param` = VALUE(`request_param`), `client_ip` = VALUE(`client_ip`), `client_ua` = VALUE(`client_ua`), `updated_at` = VALUE(`updated_at`);
mapper.select: SELECT `user_email` AS `userEmail`, `request_uri` AS `requestUri`, `request_param` AS `requestParam`, `client_ip` AS `clientIp`, `client_ua` AS `clientUa`, `updated_at` AS `updatedAt` FROM `planat`.`user_tracks` WHERE `user_email` = #{userEmail} LIMIT 1
